name: Kathmandu
description: The valley's living museum — Boudhanath's prayer flags, Durbar Square's carved temples, and alleyways that smell of incense and dal bhat.

name: Pokhara
description: A lakeside town under the Annapurna range — paragliding at sunrise, Phewa Lake at dusk, and the gateway to the high trails.

name: Everest Base Camp
description: Sixteen days through Sherpa villages and high passes to stand at the foot of the world's highest mountain.

name: Chitwan
description: Nepal's first national park — rhinos along the Rapti River, jungle walks, and a sunset canoe ride through the sal forest.

name: Lumbini
description: The birthplace of the Buddha — a quiet garden of monasteries built by nations across the Buddhist world, around the Maya Devi Temple.

name: Annapurna
description: A circuit through rhododendron forest and high alpine terrain into a natural amphitheatre of 7,000m peaks.
